flags.message: gemini-baseline's retrieval.md states no retrieval beyond provisioned inputs, but its harness log records two corpus-query attempts for granted other-acts cases (calls 12 and 13). Both results are unobserved, so successful retrieval, failure, and returned content cannot be established. The disclosure should record the attempts and uncertainty. This is not evidence of this petition's outcome leaking: the calls occurred before resolution and did not target its disposition; leakage_suspected remains false.
